# git: alias: single entry point x instead of current approach

Replace the many top-level git aliases with one: `git x <command>`, dispatching to the dotfiles' functions. **Motivation:** "simplify experience and avoid learning inappropriate patterns. Proxy is preferable to alias" — a single namespace makes it obvious which commands are the author's, avoids collisions with future built-in git commands, and puts help/completion in one place.

```bash
$ git x contrib
# instead of
# git contrib
```
